messages:
Zoe (partnerships): Quick sync: were starting CloudStore Lite listing across AWS/GCP/Azure. Day0 scope: publisher creds, VM/images, SKU/tier packaging, trial flow, KMS requirements, and listing assets. Owners?
Liam (product): I'll take SKU, trial UX and sample snippets. Thinking 14-day auto trial with 8k token credit.
Rina (legal): I'll draft a short EULA + DPA blurb. Need to know telemetry retention default and EU export options. Will aim for Tue EOD.
Otis (cloud-ops): I'll own publisher onboarding and IAM templates. Request AWS acct: 012345678901, GCP proj: cloudstore-staging. Will prepare terraform snippets for assume-role and KMS.
Devon (engineering): I'll do image builds: AMI, GCP image, Azure VHD. Plan: nightly bake, smoke test (boot + /health + sample inference). Need build access and a minimal test harness.
Liam (product): Assets needed from marketing: one hero shot, two UI screenshots, one short blurb, and quickstart (markdown). Can marketing deliver by Wed?
Zoe (partnerships): I'll ping marketing and set mid-week check. Target: staging listing next Friday.
Otis (cloud-ops): KMS note: for private offers we'll surface a customer-managed CMK; enable rotation. Security to confirm audit logs.
Rina (legal): CMK rotation required for enterprise. Also require explicit TOS consent at trial signup.
Devon (engineering): Will publish image IDs to SSM path /marketplace/cloudstore-lite/images and post bake logs to #eng-runtime.
marketplace-bot: Tasks created: MKT-900 (assets) -> marketing, due 1797780000; INF-901 (publisher creds + tf) -> Otis, due 1797770000; PRD-902 (trial UX + pricing) -> Liam, due 1797773600; LEG-903 (EULA + DPA) -> Rina, due 1797800000; ENG-904 (image bake) -> Devon, due 1797777200.
Zoe (partnerships): Action recap and mid-week sync Thu 9:30am PT. If any blocker appears, flag here or DM me. Thanks!
